Growing healthy; strenghtening healthcare for Mexican Children

description.narrative: The proposed loan operation aims at strengthening the Mexican Health Care Sector. The focus will be on the program; Medical Insurance for the New Generation. the goal of this program is to protect families against financial risks due to health care expenditures. The program finances healthcare for children born since december 2006.
